caption: Figure 1: Object semantics for open-ended naming and spatial prediction. (a) Spatial prediction produces object queries for LLM-based naming. (b) UniOSE enriches these queries with image-derived regional semantics and uses them for training-time detection matching and mask conditioning. Semantic guidance originates from the enriched query before LLM-based naming. (c) Comparison of box recall@0.75 and naming accuracy. Swin and SAM denote Open-Det Swin-T and its fully fine-tuned SAM2-T backbone variant, respectively. The protocol, metric definitions, and source results are provided in Appendix A.1.
delegated_acceptance_review: Actually viewed final and initial draft, read the detailed original caption and all independent checks. Original prior/UniOSE architectures, query counts, brown semantic-guidance return, two cat images, and full Swin/SAM scatter are intact. The footer explicitly names UniOSE as the enrichment method and identifies the plot as an Open-Det Swin-T versus fine-tuned SAM2-T baseline comparison. Opposing recall and naming-accuracy changes are directly visible in the retained measurements; no UniOSE result is implied.
